Morgan: FYI noticed a p95 spike on long-tail requests after yesterday's autotune tweak. looks correlated to kernel-path changes + continuous batching
Sam: which tweak? the one preferring fused kernels for tall sequences?
Morgan: exactly. autotune now prefers kernel_family=fused when est_seq_len > 4096. mixed with cont-batching we're seeing repeated launch/warmup costs
Kai: can you share a trimmed perf snapshot from prod? paste the hot lines
Morgan: pasted below
```
[trace] kernel=fused_mm    0.58ms
[trace] kernel=dot_vec     0.14ms
[meta] launch_overhead    0.95ms
[kv]   miss_rate=0.47 -> 0.06 after 4 tokens
[batch] size=6 -> 14 during combine
```
Anika: that launch overhead is worrying if it's being charged multiple times per logical batch. fused path expands working set; KV evictions make subsequent requests pay warmup
Sam: hypothesis: cont-batching coalesces short+long reqs; autotune routes both into fused family if est_seq_len of batch average crosses threshold -> eviction/warmup thrash
Kai: did you reproduce in lab? try a 50/50 mix of 512 and 8192 seqs with contbatch on vs off
Morgan: ran quick lab run: p95(mix) cont_on=80ms, cont_off=56ms; pinned to non-fused path p95=58ms. CPU/GPU util similar
Anika: KV dump from that run:
```
0s, hits=150, misses=90, evictions=20
15s, hits=600, misses=35, evictions=140
30s, hits=820, misses=10, evictions=260
```
Kai: evictions ramp up with fused path + contbatch. aligns with warmup tail
Sam: mitigation ideas: (A) make autotune batching-aware (only pick fused when queue is homogeneous long), (B) block cont-batching from merging across kernel families, (C) KV-side: soft-pin entries referenced by long-paths during mixed windows
Anika: also consider hysteresis before switching kernel paths: require sustained estimate >N tokens or sustained latency improvement before flip
Morgan: short-term patch: add kernel_switch_hysteresis flag requiring N tokens before reroute. quick to roll out
Kai: I can push a feature-flag and run A/B tonight. command I used:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/switch_flag -d '{"flag":"kernel_switch_hysteresis","value":true,"threshold_tokens":2048}'
```
Sam: perf-bot flagged anomaly across cluster g4-3: launch_overhead p95 +28% vs baseline. deploy-bot shows autotune roll 2026-03-16T03:12Z -> canary->80%->completed
Morgan: plan: (1) rollback kernel policy for 80% to previous (2) roll out hysteresis flag to 10% and measure (3) prototype KV pin heuristic in staging
Anika: long-term: smarter routing to avoid mixing kernel families in continuous queues, or make fused kernels KV-friendly via working-set improvements
Kai: assigning tasks: I'll run the flag and attach traces; Morgan will gather prod traces and KV metrics; Anika will spike pin heuristic
Sam: create ticket RT-2146 and add checklist for release notes: note cont-batching interactions w/ autotune and KV working-set risks
perf-bot: ANOMALY detected: metric=launch_overhead p95=+28%
deploy-bot: rollout completed: autotune-v2 -> 80%
Morgan: thanks, will monitor alerts and cut rollback if p95 stays up
Kai: live run starts in ~2h, will report results. :rocket:
